analysis: Examined docs/reference/configuration.md. Per the complete range map, the changes are: the date bump at head line 3 (2026-10-21 to 2026-10-22) and one new table row at head line 414 documenting DARKBLOOM_TTFT_GDN_BLOCKED. That variable selects the Gated DeltaNet prefill kernel (stock, packed, rows or a default probe) for qwen3_5, qwen3_5_moe and prism_hadamard_qwen35 in libs/mlx-swift-lm/Libraries/MLXLLM/Models/GatedDelta.swift. Head line 414 is not within the supplied head excerpt (lines 1-353), and the patch excerpt is truncated. The visible text describes a performance-kernel selector with a bit-exact probe default. Nothing in the visible text touches prefix-cache gating or TTL (T-041), the LaunchAgent passthrough, attestation (TB-009/TB-011), encryption or keys. The base unit (lines 519-686) is unchanged context: SSD prefix cache, KEK and debug key-file controls, and memory budgets. It is consistent with T-041's mitigations. Documentation alone cannot regress controls. One question remains for kernel-level review, outside this batch: whether the forced packed/rows modes can change numerical outputs (T-007/T-027 correctness overclaim) or cause memory/availability issues. The truncated row text suggests the probe preserves bit-exactness only where verified. The forced modes are operator-chosen, which is already within ADV-001's capability. No finding.
